world_model_delta: ELEMENTAL_CYCLE ritual: occurs every 20 turns automatically. Each island's dominant element cycles forward (FIRE→WATER→AIR→EARTH→QUINT→FIRE). Elemental cycle affects faction affinity bonuses but not ownership. Cycle is simulation-clockwork — no faction triggers it.
validator_question: Does the elemental cycle affect governance standing of any faction?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — resource affinity shift only; no governance standing change
